title: Bag of Bricks-Beige 09
descriptionHtml:
Beige — colour 09

A quiet, dependable neutral. Beige bridges the gap between the pale skin tones and the warmer browns, and makes an understated background when you don't want the backdrop competing with the subject.

Works well with: Light Nougat 02, Sand 03, Nougat 32

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Beige bricks (colour 09) for Memobrick mosaics. A quiet neutral for skin tones, sand and understated backgrounds. Resealable bag, exact fit.
